package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// LearningActionAssistance atomically stores a teacher-owned summary and event.
type LearningActionAssistance interface {
	Record(ctx context.Context, assistance domain.LearningActionAssistance, event domain.IntegrationEvent) error
}

// LearningActionAssistanceFinalizer atomically deduplicates a closure and, when
// targets exist, stores the teacher summary and its outbox event.
type LearningActionAssistanceFinalizer interface {
	Finalize(
		ctx context.Context,
		closure domain.LearningActionClosed,
		assistance *domain.LearningActionAssistance,
		event *domain.IntegrationEvent,
	) (bool, error)
}
